title: Soon be calling him my lord mayor.
html_source:
Bloom predicts (correctly), that Nannetti will become Lord Mayer.

The Lord Mayor is the representative head of the city government of Dublin, elected to office annually by members of the Dublin Corporation from amongst its members. The Lord Mayor is responsible for chairing Corporation meetings, and representing the city at public events.

In June 1904, Joseph Hutchinson was lord mayor of Dublin. The correct way to call the mayor however would be “Right Honorable” and not “My lord mayor.”
